name: Hector Bryce
source:
After witnessing the murder of his mother, Hector grew into a dark and twisted individual that started to use the dark arts to rape and torture people to fulfill his own selfish needs. While typically an antagonist, there is a chance you can gain Hector as an ally on your quest.
